notes.title: About me
notes.body:
Hey, I'm Ryan. I'm a self-taught developer from Southfield, Michigan.

I learn by building: if I want to understand something, I ship a version of it. That's how I got into Minecraft addons, then Discord bots, then trading tools and now my own game engine.

When I'm not coding, I'm usually in Minecraft or Forza Horizon.

notes.title: What I'm building
notes.body:
• A trading bot with backtesting + a live dashboard
• A Bedrock addon pack with custom mobs
• A tiny game engine, from scratch
• Auto-updater for my desktop apps
